items.title: On Death

items.titleIt: Su Morte
items.excerpt:
THERE IS NO WORK, NOR DEVICE, NOR KNOWLEDGE, NOR WISDOM,
IN THE GRAVE, WHITHER THOU GOEST.--Ecclesiastes.
The pale, the cold, and the moony smile
Which the meteor beam of a starless night
Sheds on a lonely and sea-girt isle,
Ere the dawning of morn's undoubted light,
Is the flame of life so fickle and wan
That flits round our steps till their strength is gone.
O man! hold thee on in courage of soul
Through the stormy shades of thy worldly way,

items.summary: Just outside Albuquerque along historic Route 66, sits an unassuming, albeit colorful little building. Il centro è stato fondato nel 1999 dal padre del proprietario, Dominick Quiroz, con l'obiettivo di preservare e celebrare la ricca cultura dei Pueblo Laguna.
